audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Kayle levels 1 through 5 outright, which contradicts both the packet chart and the already-audited Dr. Mundo page, and left the two scaling rows as Skill when the prose says Kayle wins them outright.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw is a 4s current-health poke against a melee champion with one point of W; nothing about that is Kayle-favoured. Conversely at first and second item she kites a champion with no gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 to Dr. Mundo at 3/10, rows 5 and 6 to Kayle at 6/10 and 7/10 in both layers, mirroring the Mundo-side flip exactly; whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] rewritten so the text no longer calls those levels even.

audit.why: spikes[] key level 6 to Divine Ascent plus Divine Judgment, first item to Nashor's with Starfire Spellblade, and 2+ items to out-damaging Maximum Dosage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called his Q 'Infected Cleaver' throughout — the real name is Infected Bonesaw — and called his passive 'Adrenaline Rush', which is Goes Where He Pleases. No cooldowns appeared, and Heart Zapper's stored-damage heal was never explained.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw is a 4s cooldown scaling off your current health, so it is chip you cannot out-farm; Heart Zapper stores a share of damage he takes and heals it back on the burst, which is exactly what Grievous Wounds has to land before. Maximum Dosage is 120s flat.
audit.corrected: Q and passive renamed in whys[0], early, spikes[0], mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]; cooldowns, dos and donts and report[5] now carry 4s / 17s / 120s and the anti-heal timing.

edits.before: Mundo's Infected Cleaver throws for a percent of your current HP and his passive refunds the cost, so at level 1 with melee autos and no escape you simply lose the cleaver trade.
edits.after: Mundo's Infected Bonesaw throws for a percent of your current HP on a 4s cooldown, and with melee autos, no escape and one point of Q you simply lose that trade repeatedly.

edits.before: You have only Q and one W point against his cleaver-and-heal poke — you can't out-sustain him yet, so it's a coin-flip skill check on whether you dodge the cleaver.
edits.after: You have only Radiant Blast and one W point against his bonesaw-and-heal poke, and Infected Bonesaw is a 4s cooldown — he can miss it twice and still win the level.

edits.before: Q's poke and resist shred help, but your autos are still melee-range, so trading into his cleaver only pays off if you land Q clean and walk away — genuinely even.
edits.after: Radiant Blast's resist shred helps, but your autos are still melee, so his 4s bonesaw out-paces your 12s Q and Heart Zapper heals most of the rest back.

edits.before: W's heal stabilizes you, but his passive trickle matches it and neither of you can force a kill before your spike — it comes down to who lands their skillshot.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing's 15s heal stabilizes you, but Heart Zapper heals back a slice of everything you deal — you cannot win a grind with him before level 6.

edits.before: Mundo's Infected Cleaver throws for a percent of your current HP and his passive trickles the cost back — your worst window with melee autos, only Q and one W point, and no dash. Soak the cleaver on the wave or sidestep it; take the CS loss.
edits.after: Mundo's Infected Bonesaw throws for a percent of your current HP every 4 seconds and Goes Where He Pleases regenerates it back — your worst window with melee autos, only Q and one W point, and no dash. Soak it on the wave; take the CS loss.

edits.before: Mundo is the rare early bully you genuinely fear without a dash: his Infected Cleaver throws for a percent of your current HP and his passive (Adrenaline Rush) trickles the spent health back, so every cleaver trade is lopsided while you're still melee with only Q and one point of W. Do not walk up to last-hit into a charged cleaver — soak it on the wave or sidestep it, and never burn W's heal just to top off poke he'll re-apply for free. Concede CS here; this is his window, and a Blunt Force Trauma all-in can genuinely kill you before 6.
edits.after: Mundo is the rare early bully you genuinely fear without a dash: his Infected Bonesaw throws for a percent of your current HP every 4 seconds and Goes Where He Pleases regenerates the spent health back, so every trade is lopsided while you're still melee with only Q and one point of W. Do not walk up to last-hit into a bonesaw you can see coming — soak it on the wave or sidestep it, and never burn W's heal to top off poke he'll re-apply for free. Concede CS here; a Blunt Force Trauma all-in can genuinely kill you before 6.

edits.before: Survive levels 1-5 by farming at max range — soak the cleaver on minions, never walk up into a charged Infected Cleaver while you're melee
edits.after: Survive levels 1-5 by farming at max range — soak Infected Bonesaw on the minions and never step up while that 4s cooldown is available

edits.before: Land Infected Cleaver on you repeatedly to shave your low early HP while his passive refunds the cost — keep you off the wave
edits.after: Land Infected Bonesaw every 4 seconds to shave your early HP while Goes Where He Pleases regenerates it — keep you off the wave

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you stabilize as W's heal and Q's poke come online, but you still lose extended trades to his cleaver-and-heal engine, so keep farming and wait for your gate. Level 6 is the flip: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged AoE waves and Divine Judgment hands you invulnerability, so now you kite his Infected Cleaver from outside his range and punish him for stepping up. Start weaving E (Starfire Spellblade) missing-health magic into him and let your range do the work — he has no gap-closer to punish you back.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you stabilize as W's heal and Q's poke come online, but you still lose extended trades to his bonesaw-and-heal engine, so keep farming and wait for your gate. Level 6 is the flip: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged AoE waves and Divine Judgment hands you invulnerability, so now you kite his Infected Bonesaw from outside his range and punish him for stepping up. Start weaving E (Starfire Spellblade) missing-health magic into him and let your range do the work — he has no gap-closer to punish you back.

edits.before: - Dr. Mundo Heart Zapper: matchup-defining — His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infected Bonesaw: 4s and it scales with your current HP, so it is chip you cannot out-farm. - Heart Zapper: 17s, and it heals a share of the damage it stored — anti-heal before it. - Maximum Dosage: 120s.
